items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy 'what if' geography Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how cool this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy), build excitement through each line, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Plot twist' gets a playful, knowing, excited lift. 'But that's not even the weirdest part' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'It went nowhere.' and 'It's still waiting.' are deadpan and funny. The last line trails off unfinished on 'Because honestly...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy, about 175 words per minute, short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Accent: native General American English narrator, neutral American accent from the first word to the last. Say GTA as the letters G-T-A. Pronounce 'Tallahassee' as 'tal-uh-HASS-ee' and 'Conch' as 'konk' (rhymes with 'honk'). Read ONLY the text provided, word for word, every line in order; never add words of your own.
lines: What if Vice City... became its own country?
In G-T-A six, it's a city. In real life... it's Miami.
And Miami's metro area has over six million people.
So what would this country get?
An economy of over five hundred billion dollars...
And a capital that's finally close. Tallahassee is over four hundred miles away.
But here's the twist: they already tried.
In twenty fourteen, the city of South Miami voted... three to two...
to split Florida in half and make a fifty-first state.
But that's not even the weirdest part.
In nineteen eighty-two, Key West actually seceded... as the Conch Republic.
It declared war on the United States...
and asked for one billion dollars in aid.
So... Vice City, or Florida? Because honestly...
